description: This file defines the PeriodicGraphCheckpointer class, which manages persisting and checkpointing of Graph objects in Spark's GraphX, including automatic handling of checkpoint intervals, persistence, and cleanup of checkpoint files.

classes.name: PeriodicGraphCheckpointer
classes.description: A class that extends PeriodicCheckpointer to manage checkpointing and persistence of Graph objects in Spark's GraphX, with automatic interval-based checkpointing and cleanup.

methods.name: checkpoint
methods.description: Overrides the checkpoint method to invoke checkpoint on the Graph.

methods.name: isCheckpointed
methods.description: Checks if the Graph has been checkpointed.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Persists the vertices and edges of the Graph if they are not already persisted, using cache.

methods.name: getCheckpointFiles
methods.description: Retrieves the list of checkpoint files associated with the Graph.
